New `POST /hosts/claim` endpoint: browser-driven workspace creation in one synchronous call -- lease a pool host matching the tier's pinned template + shape (fast path only), adopt the pre-baked workspace over SSH with the pool key (host record `host_name` rewrite, `workspace_display_name`/`user_created`/`is_primary` labels on the services agent, `REMOTE_SERVICE_CONNECTOR_URL` in the host env), then bring sharing up (share record + materials injection). A failure after the lease releases it (slice teardown) before the error propagates. Refused with 503 on tiers without a pinned template.

The pinned template repo/ref and optional blessed compute shape come from the tier's `deploy.toml` `[web_workspaces]` block, pushed into the connector's per-deploy Modal Secret as `MINDS_WEB_TEMPLATE_*` / `MINDS_WEB_SHAPE_*` by `minds env deploy` (which also sets `SHARE_CHROME_ORIGIN` to the connector origin for such tiers).

New `POST /keys/workspace-mint` endpoint: the hosted web chrome's twin of the desktop mint page. Mints (rotating in place on the deterministic `workspace-<host_id>` alias) a LiteLLM key against the caller's account with a $100/day rolling budget; ownership requires an ACTIVE sync record for the host id.

Resource endpoints (`/hosts/*`, `/sync/*`, `/keys/*`) now also accept the SuperTokens browser-session cookie (with a same-origin check on state-changing methods), so the path-served web chrome can call them without a bearer token. A Bearer header, when present, still wins.

The connector now serves a second frontend bundle: the `frontend_web/` web-chrome SPA, path-routed under `/web` on the connector origin (assets at `/web/assets/*`, SPA catch-all serving index.html). `minds env deploy` builds it alongside the accounts bundle.

New `frontend_web/` package: the hosted minds web chrome SPA (Mithril + Tailwind + Vite, served under `/web`). Sign-in rides the accounts browser session; the master password unlock/set/change/clear flows are wire-compatible with the desktop's secret wrapping (argon2id + AES-256-GCM, verified byte-for-byte against Python-generated vectors in vitest). Views: workspace overview with live share health, browser-orchestrated create (keypair generation in the browser, `/hosts/claim`, CAS record push with encrypted secrets, health polling, in-workspace backup provisioning over the owner-exec channel), the workspace iframe shell with a new-tab fallback and embed-contract handling (hosted mint modal for `minds:open-ai-keys-page`), destroy, and settings. The workspace SSH private key is generated in the browser (openssh-key-v1 encoding), synced only inside the encrypted record, and used to Ed25519-sign owner-exec envelopes (signature vectors byte-match the dwt service's verifier).

Fixed the share-materials injection writing to a relative path: over the raw pool-key SSH channel the working directory is the login user's home, not the workspace root, so `share.env` / `share_grants.toml` landed at `$HOME/data/.secrets/` where the share gateway never saw them (found live on dev-josh-2). The remote paths are now absolute (`/home/user/workspace/data/.secrets/...`).
